_about: Optional site settings. goatcounter: your GoatCounter code (the part before .goatcounter.com) to count page views without cookies; empty = no counter.

tutor._about: Lunch Tutor pilot panel on lunch and lab pages. enabled: show it to everyone (otherwise only with ?tutor=preview); api: Tutor API base URL (https); clientId: the Lunch Tutor app (client) ID; empty api or clientId = 'not configured yet'. See PUBLISHING.md.
